description: FTDI FT231X USB to full-handshake UART IC, QFN-20, tape and reel

pinout.name: RXD
pinout.notes: UART receive data input; Table 3.3 note 1: pulled to VCCIO via ~75k in input mode

pinout.name: 3V3OUT
pinout.notes: 3V3 regulator output, 50 mA; an input to be driven with 3V3 when VCC is 3V3

abs_max.param: DC input voltage USBDP and USBDM
DC input voltage high impedance bi-directionals (powered from VCCIO)
